lesson: Tuesday's one bet lost: Liverpool beat Villarreal 4-3 despite their injury list, so Villarreal or Draw did not pay and the $5.33 stake was lost. The read on Liverpool's squad was reasonable, but a thin edge loses often, and this was a stake sized for that. Elsewhere the favourites we avoided at short prices all won, which is why we stay out of them: Manchester City 5-1 and Roma 4-0, with Dortmund winning 2-1 at Sabah.

Prices: Wolverhampton Wanderers 1.62 / Draw 3.90 / Portsmouth 5.00. Over 2.5 1.73 / Under 2.5 2.10; BTTS Yes 1.75 / No 1.95. Wolves are W L L W L, have Jimenez, Traore, Armstrong, Gomes and Mosquera out and rotate (45% of the XI kept). Portsmouth are W W L D D and have kept 80% of their XI, but have nine players out (Arthur, Ogilvie, Shaughnessy, Brooke-Smith, Kosznovszky, Murphy, Umeh, Waddingham and others). Both squads are thin, and Wolves at 1.62 already carries that. No bet.

Prices: Liverpool 1.50 / Draw 4.40 / Villarreal 5.50. Over 2.5 1.44 / Under 2.5 2.75; BTTS Yes 1.55 / No 2.45. Liverpool are without Ekitike, Frimpong, Szoboszlai, Bradley, Leoni and Gakpo, with Isak listed as out in one report and in the predicted XI in another, and they have kept only 45% of their XI over six games. They played in the league three days earlier and are expected to rotate. Villarreal have Buchanan, Pepe and Gulacsi out but are D W L W W. A 1.50 price asks Liverpool to win comfortably with that squad, and one data model gives them under 50%. Villarreal or draw pays about 2.35, so take 2.30 or better. The edge is small, so the stake is 1%.
